title: [Activity] Introduction and Installation of Apache Spark

cues.en: So far, we've been using the 100 thousand ratings data set for MovieLens as we illustrate different recommender systems.
cues.zh: 目前，用 MovieLens 十萬筆評分，示範不同推薦系統。

cues.en: That's good enough for educational purposes but if you want to build a recommender system for a real company, you will probably be working with much more data and you certainly won't be processing it
cues.zh: 教學足夠，但替真實公司建立推薦，可能資料多得多，也肯定不會只在

cues.en: just on your own desktop PC.
cues.zh: 自己的桌機處理。

cues.en: This next section is about scaling it up, systems that exist to let you train recommender systems with really big data on a cluster, maybe even in the cloud.
cues.zh: 下一節，談擴展規模，在叢集，甚至雲端，以巨量資料訓練推薦系統。

cues.en: There are lots of options, but we'll cover a few of my favorites here.
cues.zh: 選項很多，介紹幾個我喜歡的。

cues.en: So far we've been using the 100 thousand ratings data set for MovieLens as we illustrate different recommender systems.
cues.zh: 目前，用 MovieLens 十萬筆評分，示範不同推薦系統。

cues.en: That's good enough for educational purposes but if you want to build a recommender system for a real company, you will probably be working with much more data and you certainly won't be processing it
cues.zh: 教學足夠，但替真實公司建立推薦，可能資料多得多，也肯定不會只在

cues.en: just on your own desktop PC.
cues.zh: 自己的桌機處理。

cues.en: This next section is about scaling it up, systems that exist to let you train recommender systems with real big data on a cluster, maybe even in the cloud.
cues.zh: 下一節，談擴展規模，在叢集，甚至雲端，以巨量資料訓練推薦系統。

cues.en: There are lots of options, but we'll cover a few of my favorites.
cues.zh: 選項很多，介紹幾個我喜歡的。

cues.en: You may have heard of Apache Spark.
cues.zh: 可能聽過 Apache Spark。

cues.en: It's a very powerful framework for processing massive data sets across a cluster of computers.
cues.zh: 是跨電腦叢集，處理龐大資料集的強大框架。

cues.en: As your data grows, you just keep adding more computers to your cluster, the sky's pretty much the limit.
cues.zh: 資料增加，就繼續加電腦，幾乎沒有上限。

cues.en: I'm not going to go into the details of how Spark works here, but Sundog Education offers entire courses on that topic.
cues.zh: 不深入 Spark 細節，但 Sundog Education 有整門相關課。

cues.en: For now, we'll just focus on it from a practical standpoint.
cues.zh: 目前只專注實務。

cues.en: We'll get it installed and examine some code to generate recommendations using Spark on a larger data set.
cues.zh: 安裝，研究程式，對更大資料集產生推薦。

cues.en: Since you probably don't have a cluster of your own handy, we'll still do this on your own desktop PC, but running this code on a cluster running Apache Spark would work exactly the same way.
cues.zh: 你大概沒有叢集，所以仍在自己的桌機做，但相同程式，在 Spark 叢集，運作完全相同。

cues.en: Think of it as running on a cluster of one computer for now, which is your PC.
cues.zh: 先視為一台電腦的叢集，就是你的電腦。

cues.en: If you want to follow along with your own PC in this section first you need to get Spark installed.
cues.zh: 想跟著本機操作，先安裝 Spark。

cues.en: And on Windows, that's a bit of a hassle.
cues.zh: Windows 上有點麻煩。

cues.en: But here are the steps you need to follow, whatever OS you're using.
cues.zh: 但不管哪種作業系統，步驟如下。

cues.en: If you're not comfortable with setting environment variables on your OS, you should probably just watch the next few videos because you'll probably run into trouble otherwise.
cues.zh: 如果不熟悉環境變數，接下來幾支影片，也許只看示範，否則可能遇到麻煩。

cues.en: You need to know what you're doing with environment variables for this to all work properly and there are a lot for frustrating little things that can do wrong.
cues.zh: 必須知道環境變數怎麼設，才能正常運作，有很多令人挫折的小問題。

cues.en: The first step is to install the Java 8 SDK from Oracle's website.
cues.zh: 第一步，到 Oracle 網站，安裝 Java 8 SDK。

cues.en: And make sure it is Java 8 and not Java 9 or newer.
cues.zh: 確定是 Java 8，不是 Java 9 或更新。

cues.en: Spark only works with Java 8 right now.
cues.zh: 目前 Spark 只支援 Java 8。

cues.en: When you install it, you need to be sure to install it to a path that does not include and spaces.
cues.zh: 安裝時，路徑不能有空白。

cues.en: So on Windows, that means you can't accept the default location under program files because there is a space between program and files.
cues.zh: Windows 不能接受 Program Files 預設位置，因為 Program 與 Files 之間有空格。

cues.en: Use a new path, like C:JDK or something, That's easy to remember and has no spaces in it.
cues.zh: 用 C:\JDK 這類容易記、沒有空白的新路徑。

cues.en: Then you need to set the JAVA_HOME environment variable on your system to the path you installed the Java 8 JDK into.
cues.zh: 把系統 JAVA_HOME，設成 Java 8 JDK 安裝路徑。

cues.en: In Windows, environment variables are set using the system control panel.
cues.zh: Windows 環境變數，在系統控制台設定。

cues.en: From there, you select advanced system settings and then you'll see a button to go into your environment variables.
cues.zh: 選進階系統設定，會看到環境變數按鈕。

cues.en: Then next steps are specific to Windows.
cues.zh: 接下來是 Windows 專用。

cues.en: Since Spark uses the hadoop distributed file system for some things, it won't run unless it thinks hadoop is installed on your PC.
cues.zh: Spark 部分功能用 Hadoop 分散式檔案系統，除非認為電腦有 Hadoop，否則無法執行。

cues.en: We can fool it by copying the win utils exe file provided with your course materials in the scaling up folder
cues.zh: 把教材 ScalingUp 資料夾附的 winutils.exe，複製到

cues.en: into C win utils bin.
cues.zh: C:\winutils\bin，就能讓它認為已安裝。

cues.en: And then, setting the hadoop home environment variable
cues.zh: 再設定 HADOOP_HOME 環境變數，

cues.en: to C:/winutils.
cues.zh: 為 C:\winutils。

cues.en: At this point you should restart your PC to make sure all those new environment variables have taken effect.
cues.zh: 此時，重新啟動電腦，確保新環境變數生效。

cues.en: Finally, you need to install the py spark package into your RecSys environment using Anaconda Navigator.
cues.zh: 最後，用 Anaconda Navigator，將 pyspark 安裝到 RecSys。

cues.en: One more thing, if you already have Spark installed and the Spark home environment variable set, you need to make sure that you have the same version of Spark installed that the py spark package installed
cues.zh: 還有，如果已安裝 Spark、設定 SPARK_HOME，要確保 Spark 版本，與 pyspark 安裝到

cues.en: into Anaconda.
cues.zh: Anaconda 的相同。

cues.en: Usually this is whatever the latest version is.
cues.zh: 通常是最新版本。

cues.en: If you have different Spark versions installed in your machine, you'll get weird errors about the Java gateway process exiting before sending its port number that make no sense.
cues.zh: 版本不同，會出現奇怪錯誤，說 Java gateway 在送出埠號前退出，令人不解。

cues.en: Once you've completed these steps, we can move on and start playing with Apache Spark.
cues.zh: 完成後，就能開始實驗 Spark。
